In January 2025 I joined the [Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF)](https://www.zalf.de/en/Pages/ZALF.aspx) in Müncheberg, Germany, as a Research Scientist. I work in the Research Platform *Simulation and Data Science*, in the Working Group *Multi-Scale Modelling and Forecasting (MSM)*, and contribute to the [Leibniz-Lab Systemic Sustainability (LL SYSTAIN)](https://www.ll-systain.org/) project.

My work there covers:

- machine learning workflows for **multi-scale crop yield forecasting** and scenario analysis, integrating climate, soil and biodiversity indicators;
- processing and harmonising large Earth observation and agricultural datasets (Sentinel, MODIS, soil grids);
- co-designing sustainability indicators that link agricultural productivity and ecological resilience, together with interdisciplinary teams.
